reviews.text: TJ, of Honest Restoration, is amazing! He is honest, courteous, attentive, thorough, and knowledgeable! We had such a positive experience and highly recommend him. He dealt with cleaning and mold related to the central air conditioner, and we would not hesitate to utilize his services with any issues that may occur in the future!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much Scott! Was such a pleasure serving you and your family. Hope your stay has been lovely and hope you guys get to check out that incredible audiobook! 😁 …

reviews.text: We recently had the pleasure of working with TJ of Honest Restorations after our church building unexpectedly flooded, and we couldn't be more impressed. From the moment we contacted Honest Restorations early one Sunday morning, they were incredibly prompt in their response, showing a level of professionalism that sets them apart. The fresh, clean scent after the mold remediation truly speaks to their dedication to excellence. Additionally, the kindness and courteousness demonstrated by TJ made the entire process easy. We highly recommend Honest Restorations for anyone in need of restoration services.

There are not enough amazing things to say about TJ. Not only was he incredibly communicative through my restoration process (I live states away from my secondary residence), he went above and beyond to ensure my home was put back together and in perfect condition. TJ was transparent about pricing, thorough with his diagnosis and suggested path forward, and kept me in the loop through the entire process. I would recommend him every day of the week.
reviews.owner_response: Meaghan thank you so much for the kind words!! You were also wonderful to work with. You have a great home there in SRB and the next owners will be lucky to be there. Stay in touch!

reviews.text: Incredible experience working with TJ and Honest Restoration! Extremely responsive and did above and beyond than what we needed without hesitation. Would absolutely recommend to anyone and use again!

If I could, I’d give Honest Restoration 10 stars.

I called TJ to help us with what ended up being a reasonably sized remediation project in our newly purchased home. He was immediately responsive, informative, and so helpful. He soon got underway on work (in a tropical storm no less), and while he was here it became clear we had a myriad of other issues to deal with. In the middle of the storm as our roof leaked, TJ jumped into action, providing fans, checking the attic, and just generally going above and beyond. He helped to assemble and lead a team of experts to ensure we had everything taken care of, following up frequently and providing support where needed. He was communicative, clear, and responsive whenever we had a question or concern. Honestly, he treated us like family, and it was one of the best customer service experiences I have ever had, period. Cannot recommend highly enough!!

I am very pleased with the work I received from TJ. He was very knowledgeable about my situation and even helped me other issues I had around my house. He was very polite and friendly. By the time he left I felt like we were actually friends. Such a good guy. Thank you for the great service!

TJ from Honest Restoration went above and beyond our expectations. The services he provided for mold inspection and removal at our condo were thorough and very reasonably priced. We live out of state and TJ communicated with us through frequent emails with photos and video showing his progress. I highly recommend Honest Restoration!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you for the kind review Tamara! Was a pleasure helping you and the family. You guys were great to work for. I appreciate your business and the time you took to leave a review. Thanks Tamara!

reviews.text:
Honest Restoration has been a life saver for my business. I run a small commercial studio and I needed somebody to handle my remodel and renovations. TJ always showed up on time and went above and beyond to make sure I had access to the resources I needed for the job.

During the remodel we discovered we had a pest problem. He had the solution and solved the problem the same day! Honest Restoration is my go to team for all of my handy work needs!!!!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much for the kind words! Love supporting your studio with my hammer and my hands. Love seeing the progress we have made and look forward to finishing that corner!
